items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: Actually, my grandmother was more like my mother than my mother, and we were very, very close. And her name was Malvina Smith Reed.

ctx.x: Yeah. We lived with was my grandparents, because we had to stay close (?) to somebody(?). Actually, my grandmother was more like my mother than my mother, and we were very, very close. And her name was Malvina Smith Reed. Her father was John Smith. He's as far as I know back from that side of the family -- my great-grandfather, John Smith. And we lived there with them. And she was... She had a lot of things she could do well also.
I read ...(?)... that a grandfather of yours was a musician.
